encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

ΕΛΟΝΤΙ Ο. ceterae varietates (cf. quae Hertzius adnotavit) nihil ad rem faciunt. quamvis facilis sit Meinekii emendatio et frequentes apud Atticos pleonasmi quales ἀληθῶς τῷ ὄντι, εὐθὺς παραχρῆμα, εὐθὺς κατὰ τάχος, ἄλλως μάτην, alii (Lobeck. Phryn. 753 sq.), σχεδόν τι ἐγγὺς τρεῖς ὅλους μῆνας numquam ullum Graecorum scriptorum dixisse credo. nam apud Platonem quidem Tim. 21 b σχεδὸν ἐγγὺς ἤδη τῶν ἐνενήκοντα ἐτῶν praepositio est ἐγγύς, non adverbium. itaque cum notum sit quantopere in Prisciani codicibus fere corrupta sint graeca, non temerariam iudico coniecturam paullo audaciorem ὀνειροπολοῦντα μῆνας ἐγγὺς τρεῖς ὅλους φρουρῶ τὸν Ἐνδυμίωνα. dormiebat enim diutissime. cf. Aristoph. Eq. 809 (Nub. 16. 27). Plat. Reip. 7, 534 c. Leg. 10, 904 d. Tim. 52 b.
